summary: Cre8 Enterprise Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing record customer counts and backlog as of June 30, 2026. The company, a Hong Kong financial printing services provider, reported 550 customers, up 17.8% from December 31, 2025, and 64 IPO filing submissions to HKEX versus 11 a year earlier. The filing contains only operational metrics and forward-looking statements; no financial results, transactions, or corporate actions are disclosed. It is a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tenders, or restructuring.
